overview: Miyaco Global Books is a multi-user business management platform for tracking sales, purchases, inventory, customers, and gross margin in real time.
features: Track inventory with cartons, units per carton, and cost price
Record sales, credit sales, purchases, and credit purchases with full quantity data
Autocomplete item names from existing inventory when recording transactions
Automatically deduct sold items from inventory in real time
Validate stock availability before allowing sales
Live gross margin and total inflow dashboard updates after every transaction
Multi-location inventory with transfer between branches
Admin approval workflow for non-admin transactions
